title.narrative: Strengthening TB/HIV Collaboration to Reduce Morbidity and Mortality - Liberia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Liberia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health and Social Welfare (MOH)This program has the following goals: To stop new HIV infections in Liberia. To turn around the tuberclosis epidamic in Liberia. Keep PLHIV alive and healthy in Liberia. To mitigate socio-economic impact on people infected and affected by HIV and AIDS in Liberia. The objectives of this program are: To pursue high quality DOTS expansion and enhancement. To address TB-HIV, MDR-TB, and the needs of poor and vulnerable populations. To contribute to health system strengthening based on primary health care. To engage all care providers. To empower people with TB, and communities through partnership. To enable and promote research. To increase access to HIV prevention and treatment services. To provide HIV prevention information and services to key and vulnerable populations. To increase care and support for PLHIV. Strengthen national health and community systems
